A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DCSM research. All 21 pages of each version, including Appendices A–F, are readable; the text, equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original DCSM benchmark results in Tables 2–5, ablations, scaling experiments, and empirical and simulation analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results, ablations, scaling experiments, and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The frozen CLIP encoders, token–patch similarity maps, functional-row replacement, two-layer CNN scorer, contrastive objective, and LLM-assisted open-vocabulary procedure remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain Objaverse-derived synthetic and COCO2017 training data, the same attribute-binding, spatial-reasoning and negation benchmarks, Sugarcrepe/VL-Checklist open-vocabulary evaluations, and Caltech101/Flowers102 classification tests. No evaluation domain or scenario is added.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2–5. SigLIP gains a description in Section 5.2, but its results already appear in v1 Table 2; the newly cited hyperbolic and localization methods are not evaluated.

E3.justification: The documented data construction, splits, model configurations, training budgets, and evaluation procedures are retained. This includes the 27-epoch ablation training and the open-vocabulary experiments using 5k images for 12 epochs or 10k for six epochs. Calling Table 2's metric accuracy clarifies the existing evaluation.

E4.justification: Appendix C retains the same functional-row, CNN-versus-ViT, fine-tuning, MLP-scoring, classification, and scaling analyses. The object-count analysis in Figure 9 and noise simulations in Figure 10 are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 3 retains six-trial averaging and selection of the higher-scoring trained model. Figure 9 retains its 25th/75th-percentile bands. No seed information, repeated-run practice, or statistical test is added or revised.

E6.justification: The numerical entries in Tables 2–5 and plotted data are unchanged. For example, DCSM-coco remains at 39.9 on CLEVR-bind and 63.7 on WhatsUp, while open-vocabulary DCSM remains at 63.5/63.8 in Table 3. Figure 3 corrects labels without changing its heatmaps.

T1.justification: Appendix E.4 replaces informal residual-similarity reasoning with an explicit comparison to additional images and a new similarity-threshold equation, invoking Conditions 3.2/3.3 instead of 3.1/3.2. It also removes the Euclidean-distance argument for opposite left/right residuals. These are localized proof changes; the lemma statements and principal conclusions remain.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusions retain the same geometric-impossibility, DCSM/functional-row remedy, and performance claims. Removing one introductory state-of-the-art sentence does not narrow the claim retained in the conclusion.

C2.justification: Section 5.1 replaces the background-patch/register-token hypothesis with discussion of inverted CLIP attention and architectural surgery. It explains retaining unmodified features and identifies evaluation of edited CLIP models as future work. The conclusion also explicitly proposes exploring alternative embedding manifolds.

D1.justification: Section 5.2 adds SigLIP's sigmoid-loss description and removes the statement that NegCLIP's mined negatives came from all of COCO-train. These are limited documentation changes, without evidence of changed experiments. The implementation details, hyperparameters, pseudocode, LLM prompts, and code/data access information otherwise remain.

R1.justification: v2 adds hyperbolic vision-language work by Desai and Pal and localization/explainability work by Bousselham and Yi Li, while removing Darcet's register-token citation. It modestly expands discussion of alternative geometries and revises the comparison with Brody; publication-metadata updates do not constitute additional research coverage.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized prose edits, aligns Condition 4.2's wording with its existing inequality, expands explanations in the proofs, and adds acknowledgments. The main section sequence and appendix organization are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 3 replaces incorrectly repeated token-axis labels with labels matching each caption. Several captions gain bold introductory text, Tables 2 and 3 receive clearer accuracy descriptions, and text/equations reflow. No figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: Corrected Figure 3 labels, clearer Condition 4.2 wording, and expanded literature context improve clarity. However, Appendix E.4 removes explicit support for opposite left/right residuals while Lemma 4 still invokes that relation, making the theoretical exposition less self-contained. With experimental evidence unchanged, these clarity gains and proof-support concerns prevent a reliable net-quality judgment.
